title: 被動語態
point: 先問主詞是做動作的人，還是被處理的東西。主詞是被處理的一方就用 be + 過去分詞，時態由 be 動詞決定。
formula: 主詞 + be 動詞 + 過去分詞 (+ by + 執行者)

table.rule: 現在式被動：am/is/are + 過去分詞
過去式被動：was/were + 過去分詞
現在完成式被動：have/has been + 過去分詞
未來式被動：will be + 過去分詞
進行式被動：am/is/are being + 過去分詞
助動詞（must、should、can）+ be + 過去分詞

table.en: The invoice was paid. / The client paid the invoice.
table.zh: 發票已付款／客戶付了發票
table.rule: 主詞是動作的承受者用被動，主詞是做動作的人用主動

examples: The new service contract was signed by both parties on Monday.
The damaged printer was returned by the customer last week.
story: Every order at Norland Supplies is packed within 24 hours.
Last Thursday, a large order from a hotel chain was shipped by express courier.
The next morning, the boxes were delivered to the wrong address.
The mistake was fixed by the logistics team, and the hotel received its order that afternoon.

drills.prompt: Were the boxes delivered to the correct address?
drills.fix: the boxes were delivered to the wrong address，主詞 the boxes 是被送錯地址的東西。
被動句裡 by 後面接做動作的人，所以處理的是物流團隊。

drills.prompt: All expense reports must ___ by Friday.
drills.fix: 報告是被提交的一方，助動詞 must 後面接 be + 過去分詞。
